description: Update a client's contact info (phone, email, company) in all three places at once: their BAMF client record, their Notion client page property, and the agency's GoHighLevel contact (updated by email/name match, created when missing). Agency staff keys only. TWO-STEP: confirm=false (default) returns the plan only (what each of the three writes will do, or why one is skipped); call again with confirm=true only after the user approves that plan. Returns a per-target result. Never treat an earlier approval as standing permission.

client.description: Client workspace id, slug, or client name (must be a client of an agency you own, admin, or manage).

confirm.description: false returns the plan only; true writes BAMF, Notion and GoHighLevel.

phone.description: Client phone, any format (US numbers default to +1).

name: bamf.update_client_contact
